decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service is close to the firm's established geospatial integration knowledge and benefits from in-house R&D, enabling the firm to interpret results and improve it.

The open GIS application development framework builds on the firm's core software development and geospatial capabilities, and the firm's own R&D helps it learn from early market feedback despite limited web presence.
The identity and access service for GIS applications leverages the firm's existing authentication and GIS integration knowledge, and active R&D supports assimilation and improvement.
The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's established consulting and geodata process expertise, allowing it to interpret demand and refine the offering.
